data_section_full_text:
III. SAMPLE AND DATA
The initial sample includes all firm-years with data on CEOs’ stock-based compensation
and ownership available from the Standard & Poor’s ExecuComp database for the period
1993–2000. <sup>8</sup> We exclude financial institutions (SICs between 6000 and 6999) and utilities
(SICs between 4400 and 5000) because managers in these regulated industries might have
different motivations to manage earnings (Burgstahler and Eames 2003, among others). The
final sample used for specific analyses varies due to additional data requirements and is
discussed in the empirical analysis sections.
